name: flesh_raptor.live_debug_spawn_visible_skirmisher_mcw
description: Minimal live raptor seam probe: load the clean McWilliams debug profile, spawn one hostile flesh raptor at visible skirmish range, advance a bounded window, and require same-run orbit/swoop/melee metrics. This separates stale fixture geometry from live monster-plan behavior.

steps.label: post_load_raptor_debug_spawn_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the clean McWilliams live-debug fixture loads to the normal map before spawning a flesh raptor

steps.label: debug_spawn_flesh_raptor_five_east
steps.expected_visible_fact: debug spawn monster helper returns to the live map after placing one hostile flesh raptor five tiles east

steps.label: toggle_safe_mode_off_before_raptor_debug_spawn_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: safe mode is toggled off so the bounded live raptor window is not consumed by warnings

steps.label: advance_debug_spawn_raptor_skirmish_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: bounded live turn window runs after the visible flesh-raptor spawn; feature proof depends on same-run live_plan lines

steps.label: audit_debug_spawn_flesh_raptor_live_plan
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug artifact did not contain flesh-raptor orbit live-plan lines after visible debug spawn
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run debug artifact proves the visible spawned flesh raptor reached the live monster-plan seam

evidence_contract.claim: a freshly debug-spawned flesh raptor reaches the live monster-plan seam when staged at visible skirmish range
evidence_contract.failure_rule: If this fails while unit tests pass, inspect spawn footing/LOS before treating it as a gameplay regression.
